name: Taunt
description: Taunts the enemy team and forces all opponents to attack this animal. Reduces incoming damage by [stat].

name: Poison
description: Deals [stat] of your :MAG:MAG as true damage at the end of the turn.

name: Flame
description: Deals [stat] of your :mag:MAG at the end of the turn. Applying flame on a target that already has flame will explode and deal [stat] damage to the target.

name: Freeze
description: Next turn, prevent the target from attacking. Remove a stack after triggering.

name: Attack Up
description: Increases all damage by [stat]. Cannot stack with other Attack Up buffs.

name: Attack Up+
description: Increases all damage by [stat]. Cannot stack with other Attack Up+ buffs.

name: Attack Up++
description: Increases all damage by [stat]. Cannot stack with other Attack Up++ buffs.

name: Mortality
description: Decreases all healing for this animal by [stat].

name: Celebration
description: At the end of every turn, heal [stat] of your :ipr:iPR as :hp:HP and replenish [stat] of your :imr:iMR as :wp:WP.

name: Leech
description: The caster who applied this debuff steals [stat] of incoming heals and [stat] of incoming replenishes.

name: Stinky
description: Prevents any future buffs *AND* debuffs from being applied to this animal. On success, deal [stat] :MAG:MAG to the animal. Stinky can be applied to stinky animals.

name: Stoneskin
description: Reduces incoming Physical damage by [stat] per stack. Remove all stacks upon taking damage of other types.

name: Spellskin
description: Reduces incoming Magical damage by [stat] per stack. Remove all stacks upon taking damage of other types.

name: Pest
description: At the end of the turn, each stack of pests will deal [stat] of your :MAG:MAG as magical damage to the target. Pests will leave after they deal damage.

name: Thorn Tether
description: Create a tether from the weapon owner to this animal. The owner absorbs [stat] of the incoming damage dealt, but also intercepts [stat] of healing and [stat] replenishing from the target.

name: Sin
description: When consumed, each stack deals [stat] of your :StrMag: **highest** offense stat as physical damage to an enemy.

name: Virtue
description: When consumed, each stack deals [stat] of your :StrMag: **lowest** offense stat as magical damage to an enemy.
